name: Kan-Nanmaru Corporation
summary: Kan-Nanmaru Corporation is a franchisee in Japan's food and beverage industry that runs restaurants and bars under brands such as Shoya, Nihon kaishoya, sing village, Jinbee Taro and VANSAN. Founded in 1978 as Inshoku Kigyo Co., Ltd., it took its current name in February 1995 and is headquartered in Saitama.
